parameters.name: Num
parameters.description: The number of entries per page. Default value: 100.

parameters.name: SaleId
parameters.description: The ID of the anti-DDoS diversion instance.

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description:
The status of the instance. Valid values:

- normal
- expired
- deleting
- stopped

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ddosdiversion list-instance --sale-id ddos_diversion_public_cn-xxxxxxxxxxxxx --name Test_instance. --status normal --page 1 --num 100 --region cn-hangzhou
